purpose: Teach: 万事/仕業/犯さ/家宅/別居/高等裁判所/徴税/性教育

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下、万事が混乱した事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered wartime chaos and social disruption in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, professorial tone. Gentle confirmation rather than question. Steady pace, attentive gaze. The voice of someone checking in, not interrogating.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、組織犯罪の仕業を追った事例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined organized crime activities in historical context.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest. Quick breath at the start. Slight upward lift on 'Yes'—eager to clarify. Careful enunciation. Eyes meeting hers briefly, then looking away. Respectful without fawning.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、人権を犯さぬ研究倫理を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you were careful about research ethics—protecting people's rights in your methodology, weren't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate pause before speaking. Steady, measured tone. Leaning slightly forward with genuine interest. Not checking off a box, but genuinely curious about his thinking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、家宅捜索の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I studied the legal and historical dimensions of home searches.
lines.style: Respectful reply. Slight hesitation—choosing words carefully. Soft, honest delivery. Not defensive, just precise. Small breath between clauses.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政治家の別居スキャンダル史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also touched on political scandals and separation cases in the news, didn't you?
lines.style: Conversational but engaged. Slight nod in the voice. The tone of someone genuinely following where his research has led. Warm recognition of his depth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、高等裁判所の判例研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on appellate court precedent and how decisions have shaped practice.
lines.style: Focused, clear articulation. Small uptick of pride in his voice—subtle. Direct eye contact level. Breathing naturally. No apology in the correction, just clarity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近代国家の徴税制度を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And modern systems of taxation—the financial infrastructure of the state—that was part of it too?
lines.style: Reflective, slower pace. Voice trails slightly at the end, inviting him to complete the picture. Genuinely curious about how it all connects. Warm but not presuming.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、性教育の国際比較を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I compared international approaches to sex education policy and implementation.
lines.style: Clear, final statement. Slight breath of completion at the end. Head tilted forward slightly. Relief in the closing—he's said what he came to say. Quiet confidence.
